However, specific AI artifacts prevent a perfect score: 1) The dog's front paws exhibit anatomical distortion where toes blend into the floor and each other (confirmed by animal_pose_auditor showing low confidence keypoints in limb regions). 2) The contact points of the lower-row clocks lack crisp occlusion shadows, creating a slight 'floating' or melting effect against the wood. 3) While the metal texture on turtles is convincing as a statue, it lacks micro-surface imperfections typical of real cast metal, appearing slightly shader-like. These are minor-to-moderate defects that reduce authenticity but do not break the scene's coherence.
